in_sanskrit.name: Rao
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Counselor, advisor, or ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rao एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who advises, counsels, or rules. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja,' meaning king or ruler.

in_hindi.name: Rao
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Counselor, advisor, or ruler
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rao एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who advises, counsels, or rules. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja,' meaning king or ruler.

in_tamil.name: Rao
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Counselor, advisor, or ruler
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rao ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who advises, counsels, or rules. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja,' meaning king or ruler.

in_telugu.name: Rao
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Counselor, advisor, or ruler
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rao ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who advises, counsels, or rules. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja,' meaning king or ruler.

in_marathi.name: Rao
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Counselor, advisor, or ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rao हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who advises, counsels, or rules. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja,' meaning king or ruler.

in_bengali.name: Rao
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Counselor, advisor, or ruler
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rao একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who advises, counsels, or rules. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raja,' meaning king or ruler.
